nodes.title: A regex T-L1 cannot cover paraphrase: blind recall is 23/60 after the fix, as the caller-crisis floor's was 37/100. Proposal: a model check on brief text at save and publish (raise-only, like the caller judge: refuse when the model says the text tells her to pass as human or hide being an AI; the regex stays the floor). It runs offline, so latency does not matter and a stronger model can serve. It needs the owner's go and a model choice; it would be measured on a fresh blind set.
nodes.closes_when: The owner chooses a model check or accepts the regex floor alone.
